page.overview:
What is Farce Island?

Farce Island is an island in the East Blue. It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!.

Farce Island is a large, mostly sand-covered island. It has little vegetation, mostly clustered along its shores, with palms trees dotted across the land. Additonally, the island contains many individual rocky mountains spread across it, with small forests clustered around them. It hosts at least two lighthouses, as well as many standalone buildings such as towers and shops.

The island is large enough to have wide rivers full enclossed within the island. They are so large, in fact, that standalone islands exist fully contained within them.

It is located between Dawn Island and the Grand Line.
